title: sedum rupestre subsp. elegans
intro: Sedum rupestre subsp. elegans, commonly known as mountain stonecrop, is a succulent plant species that belongs to the family Crassulaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as inflammation, digestive problems, and skin irritations. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its therapeutic actions, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, attributed to its bioactive constituents like flavonoids, phenolic acids, and saponins. The health benefits of Sedum rupestre subsp. elegans also include its potential to modulate the immune system and protect against oxidative stress.
